title: Trade
description: Selling a controlled substance on the street (D78, D82): whom you buy from and at what weights and prices, what a sale is, when buyers come to the corner, who sees, the heat it draws, and what holding and selling are charged as. The figures trace to CALIBRATION.md.

names.description: Whom the supplier is drawn from.

supplier.description: When the supplier can be found, and what they sell: a weight in tenths of a gram for a price in cents.

sale.description: What one buyer takes, in tenths of a gram, and pays, in cents.

corner.description: The corner where buyers come: in each hour of the day, the odds in percent that a buyer comes in each ten minutes; and of the town's people out on the street that hour, how many in a thousand pass the corner.

seen.description: The odds in percent a sale is seen and told of: a base, more for each person passing, in tenths of a percent, and more for heat, one percent for so many points; never above the most (tune).

heat.description: The police's attention to the corner and to you: points for a sale and for one seen, and what is kept of them each day, in ten-thousandths (tune).

possession.description: What holding it is charged as: the first whose weight covers what you hold, and your record.

delivery.description: What selling it, or holding it to sell, is charged as: the first whose weight covers it, and your record.
